operator: Antigravity (sovereign), only when convened by the Director
credentials: NONE. No production, no Supabase/VPS/cloud, no real data, no real role names

environment.required: fresh local PostgreSQL cluster (initdb) on the operator workstation, major version OBSERVED and recorded (not assumed), contrib btree_gist and pgcrypto available
creation: initdb into a new empty directory
start the cluster listening on a unix socket / loopback only
environment.connection: C1_LOCAL_DSN (socket or loopback; never committed or printed) and C1_MARKER=<id>

evidence_to_return: full JSON printed by the harness (no DSN)
sha256 of every file below (this manifest)
operator, date, whether the cluster was destroyed
